subject: Kiln thinking
text:
Hi again,

I keep thinking about the tiny pottery kiln you mentioned. If you go for one, I would check secondhand models first, because a beginner kit can cost more than needed for testing the waters. Also, take short notes after each firing; it helps spot what changes after glaze batches. My old club did that, and it saved me hours of guessing. Anyway, hope the weekend stays calm! It made choosing the right clay much less painful over time for me, too.
